parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban, border/document friction, or police targeting is documented; statutory self-declaration and long reform trajectory are positive climate signals only. Against this, police-recorded anti-trans hate rose 42% to 229 in 2023 and is stated to be undercounted, while a 2025 trans-specific survey found ~20% threatened and 8% physically assaulted over four years among residents, with event cancellations and a worsening street climate. That indicates societal hostility/friction, though not organised targeting. No visitor-facing remedy, prosecution outcome, border practice, or custody placement is documented, so protection cannot be credited as operating and custody/border remain open questions, not established exposures. This places it in reduced-risk, below acceptance-plus-working-remedies tiers.
